description: Discover enabled image and/or video models with aspect ratios, durations, reference requirements, whether the agent can run them, and price: baseCredits (one image, or the cheapest supported video duration) and creditsByDuration for videos. Prices are list prices for planning; get the exact charge with quote: true on playground_media_generate or playground_node_run (or the *_quote tools). kind filters to image or video models; omit it for both. Discovery is optional: quote a known/requested model directly instead of listing the catalog before every generation. Read-only.

kind.description: Model family to list: image or video; omit to list both. image, video, or all (default).

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.
